text:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy to green pool at 22:05 UTC within 22:00-22:30 change window. Release artifact: infra/router-service@sha256:9f3c... Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/infra-router/2026-03-20 :rocket:

sam: Quiet window confirmed 22:00-22:30 UTC. I'll kick off a weighted swing at +5% -> green at 22:05, ramp every 5m by +15% up to 60%. Will run warmup at 10% for 5m.

tara: Heads up — pin session-affinity for this cutover (user sessions should stay sticky for 30m). Set header cookie pinning: `router.conf.session_affinity=30m`.

miguel: Oncall procedure: if HTTP 5xx > 3% sustained over 5m OR overall p95 latency increases by >150ms from baseline -> manual rollback. Oncall-bot will alert at thresholds. I'll be watching metrics on grafana dashboard `infra/router/cutover-219850`.

nina: Suggest starting canary at 5% for 3 minutes, then to 10% for 5m, then +20% steps. Keep an eye on error budget; if any auth failures spike, we hold.

sam: Plan: 22:05 -> 5%, 22:08 -> 10% (warmup), 22:13 -> 30%, 22:18 -> 50%, 22:23 -> 70% then final 100% after validation. Will post status after each step.

deploy-bot: Executing step 1 -> `routectl shift --dst green --weight 5`

router-system: CHANGE APPLIED: green pool weight=5% from blue (operators: sam)

sam: Green health ok, no 5xx, p50 latency unchanged. Holding 3m per plan.

deploy-bot: Executing step 2 -> `routectl shift --dst green --weight 10`

router-system: CHANGE APPLIED: green pool weight=10%

miguel: Noticing slight spike in auth error rate +0.4% relative. Overall 5xx still <1%. Hold at 10% while I check logs.

sam: Holding. Tara, did we confirm cookie header rollout?

tara: cookie pin set, propagation done. Running a quick `tcpdump` on edge to confirm cookie present.

oncall-bot: ALERT CHECK: 5xx rate threshold=3% (ok). p95 latency threshold=+150ms (ok). Auth-failure threshold=0.5% (currently 0.45%).

nina: If auth-fail crosses 0.6% in the next 2m we should rollback to blue and throttle. Otherwise I think we can continue to 30% once miguel gives green.

miguel: Root cause trace suggests upstream auth cache miss for a subset of users due to slightly different header shape on new route. Sending patch to router edge config; propose we pin to older header normalization for 20m to avoid risk: `edge.header_norm=v1`

sam: That's fine. Patch applied to edge via canary. Will re-run 10% health checks in 2m.

router-system: EDGE PATCH APPLIED: header_norm=v1 (canary)

sam: Health OK after patch. Auth failures back to baseline. Proceeding to 30% now.

deploy-bot: Executing step 3 -> `routectl shift --dst green --weight 30`

router-system: CHANGE APPLIED: green pool weight=30%

miguel: Observed small increase in p95 (+20ms) but within SLO. 5xx still <1%. Approving ramp.

nina: Proceed to 50% as planned.

deploy-bot: Executing step 4 -> `routectl shift --dst green --weight 50`

router-system: CHANGE APPLIED: green pool weight=50%

sam: At 50% now. Running load-sensitive paths smoke tests.

oncall-bot: METRIC CHECK: p50/p95/p99 within expected ranges. No new alerts.

nina: Given the earlier auth flap, let's hold at 50% for 10m, then final sweep to 100% if stable. Also add a model/version pin note to release notes: `router-service: pinned plugin-version=2.4.1` so we can quickly revert plugin-side if needed.

sam: Agreed. Holding. I'll update release notes with the pin.

deploy-bot: Release notes updated: https://redwood.internal/releases/infra-router/2026-03-20#notes (pinned plugin-version=2.4.1).

miguel: After 10m hold no regressions. Proceed to final ramp to 100% at 22:35 UTC (outside change window but agreed by owners). Will do one more 15% step then full cutover.

sam: Executing final ramp -> `routectl shift --dst green --weight 80`

router-system: CHANGE APPLIED: green pool weight=80%

sam: Finalizing -> `routectl shift --dst green --weight 100`

router-system: CHANGE APPLIED: green pool weight=100%

deploy-bot: Deploy complete. All traffic on green pool. :white_check_mark:

nina: Post-mortem notes: add runbook entry about header normalization mismatch and to include header schema check in preflight.

miguel: I'll open a follow-up ticket for an automated header schema test.

sam: Thanks team. Leaving pins in release notes for 24h. If nothing else, we'll remove pin tomorrow during maintenance. :thumbsup:
